provider: Together AI Files API (with 100 GB fine-tune objects)

free_tier.stated: 100 GB per training file (JSONL or Parquet); SDK constant MAX_FILE_SIZE_GB = 50.1 and MULTIPART_THRESHOLD_GB = 5.0. No published total-storage quota.

egress.terms: No egress fee on the Files API. Their separate Managed Storage product is explicitly advertised with 'zero egress fees'.

interface_detail: POST https://api.together.xyz/v1/files/upload (and /v1/files/{id}/content); OpenAI-ish, `purpose` in {fine-tune, calibration, eval, batch-api}
chaining: 100 GB single objects are the largest per-object cap found in the entire LLM-provider lane — 200x OpenAI's 512 MB. If a total quota is genuinely absent, this is the highest-leverage per-object number in this dossier. Unverified.
limits_note: per-object-cap 100 GB. Multipart kicks in above 5 GB; per-part upload timeout 300 s. A client-side check (`check_file`) validates JSONL structure before upload, which is a soft write gate for the fine-tune purpose.
reliability_note: Together has no free tier — 'no free trials', $5 minimum prepaid credit required. That already fails the client's constraint. Read path unverified: /v1/files/{id}/content exists but every probe returns 401. Managed Storage is $0.16/GiB/month = $163.84/TB/month, which is 40-80x the cheap-paid lane and therefore useless even though egress is free.
confidence_note: One page read moves it to documented.
